title: Super Mario 3D World
extract: Super Mario 3D World is a 2013 platform game developed and published by Nintendo for the Wii U. It is the sixth original 3D platform game in the Super Mario series and the sequel to Super Mario 3D Land (2011). The game was re-released for the Nintendo Switch as Super Mario 3D World + Bowser's Fury in February 2021.
